needs: A graph traversal: a frontier spreading outward from a start node, ring by ring.

brief.title: Breadth first search, one ring at a time
brief.idea: Breadth first search explores a graph in rings around the start, keeping a queue of the frontier, so it reaches every node by the fewest possible edges.

beats.say: Here are seven towns joined by roads. We start at A and want the fewest roads to every other town.
beats.show: Seven circles labelled A to G appear, joined by seven lines: A to B and C, B to D and E, C to F, and E and F both to G.

beats.say: Breadth first search visits the towns in rings: everything one road away, then two roads, then three.
beats.show: Three rings centred on A are drawn faintly, then removed.

beats.say: It keeps a queue, the frontier, of towns found but not yet explored. At first it holds only A.
beats.show: A queue appears below the map holding A.

beats.say: Take A from the front, and add its neighbours, B and C, to the back. They are one road away.
beats.show: A leaves the queue and is marked done; B and C light up on the map and join the queue.

beats.say: Take B and add D and E. Take C and add F. All three are two roads from A.
beats.show: B and C are marked done in turn; D, E and F light up and join the queue.

beats.say: D has no new neighbours. E leads to G, which joins the queue at distance three.
beats.show: D is marked done with nothing added; E is taken, and G lights up and joins the queue.

beats.say: When F is explored, G has already been found, so it is not added a second time.
beats.show: F is taken; its road to G is highlighted, and G stays in the queue once.

beats.say: Last, G is taken from the queue. It has no towns left to find, and the queue is empty.
beats.show: G is marked done and the queue below the map is empty.

beats.say: Every town now carries its distance from A: zero, one, two or three.
beats.show: Each circle shows its number: A 0, B and C 1, D, E and F 2, G 3.

beats.say: Because the frontier grows one ring at a time, each number is the fewest roads from A.
beats.show: The roads that first reached each town stay bright, forming a tree out of A, while the other roads dim.

beats.say: Depth first search, diving down one road, could reach F by way of G, four roads instead of two.
beats.show: A second pass dives A, B, E, G, F, and F is labelled 4 beside its true distance of 2.
